title: Camera offset on player? (also using Galv's Cam Control)

posts.author: VinegarDude
posts.body:
just got a simple question whether i can offset the camera following the player or an event a bit, you see my game has pretty big sprites and i think the camera centering would look a bit better if it was one or two tiles offset up a bit, as of now i feel it leaves a lot of negative space on the bottom half of the screen whenever the camera follows the player or an npc.
however i am also using Galv's cam control for my game, would i have to modify some line in the plugin's script or the game's itself, how would i be able to make this small change.

posts.author: Robro33
posts.body:
VinegarDude said:
however i am also using Galv's cam control for my game, would i have to modify some line in the plugin's script or the game's itself, how would i be able to make this small change.
Click to expand...
try adjusting line 228 to something like this
Code:
var screenY = this.camTarget.screenY()*this.zoom.y - 96;

posts.author: VinegarDude
posts.body:
